todo.description: Something the user wants or needs to do.

buy.description: Something the user wants to purchase.

gro.name: grocery
gro.description: Food, beverages, and everyday household consumables typically bought at a supermarket or grocery store.

hom.name: home
hom.description: Furniture, home equipment, kitchen items, decorations, tools, and things primarily intended for the home.

ele.name: electronics
ele.description: Computers, phones, peripherals, electronic devices, cables, chargers, and other technology.

clo.name: clothing
clo.description: Clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry, and other wearable accessories.

pha.name: pharmacy
pha.description: Pharmacy, personal care, hygiene, cosmetics, and similar health-related consumer products.

hob.name: hobby
hob.description: Items primarily related to hobbies, sports, games, crafts, music, or other recreational activities.

gen.name: general
gen.description: Something to buy that does not clearly belong to another buy subcategory.

link.description: A URL or online resource the user wants to save or revisit.

note.description: General information, thought, idea, fact, reminder, or other content that does not fit another category.

media.description: A piece of media the user wants to consume, such as a movie, series, book, music, podcast, or game.

place.description: A physical place the user wants to remember, visit, or consider visiting.

event.description: A specific event or occurrence the user may want to attend or remember.

person.description: A person the user wants to remember, contact, or associate information with.

classification_rules: For buy items, choose exactly one buy subcategory.
Use the most specific applicable buy subcategory.
Do not create new categories or subcategories.
If an item is ambiguous but is clearly something to buy, use buy:gen.
If the agent cannot confidently determine the appropriate category, use note.
Prefer note over making an uncertain classification.
The category describes the primary nature or intent of the item, not merely an incidental property.
